title: Lesson 2 Checkpoint — Have / Has
description: Show what you learned about have / has. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.
canDo: I can say what I and other people have using have and has.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Have / Has: Have with I, you, we, they. Has with he, she, it. Questions and negatives use do/does + base have: Does he have a bike?
